answer: Slow-drip vesting with ring clawback: rewards vest over 30 epochs instead of paying out at once, and any account later proven to belong to a sybil ring forfeits every unvested coin across the whole ring. A raven-eyed audit can land weeks late and still bite. A farm of 500 puppets must stay undetected for a month while its capital sits frozen, and one slip claws back the lot. Honest agents just wait under a velvet glove, each reward a pearl that hardens slowly.
